title: Server fetches of user-provided image and crawl URLs resolve DNS and block private addresses
detail:
fetchRemoteImage has no guard on a public route; lib/ai/web/index.ts:118 and lib/importer/harvest/media.ts:67 check hostnames only and follow redirects. Reuse the pinned fetch from lib/qr/remote-logo.ts (#3919). Also extend the private range list (192.0.0.0/24, 198.18.0.0/15, NAT64, 6to4).

Closed by SEC-010 (#3932): lib/net/pinned-fetch.ts now backs the OG image fetch, the crawler and importer media. The original ssrf-og probe matched one implementation (remote-logo, isPrivateIp or assertPublic in remote-image.ts); the repair is a shared module, so the probe is replaced with sec-ssrf-pinned-fetch.mjs, which asserts the consequence at all three call sites.
